description:
Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) is a rural housing scheme launched by the Government of India. 

It was initiated in November 2016 to provide housing for the rural poor. 

The objective is to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all rural households living in kutcha houses. 

The scheme aims to achieve the goal of housing for all by 2022. 

Under PMAY-G, financial assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh is provided for the construction of a house in plain areas. 

For hilly states and difficult areas, the assistance is Rs. 1.30 lakh. 

Beneficiaries are also provided with a toilet facility under the scheme. 

Eligibility for PMAY-G includes being a member of a rural household without a pucca house. 

Priority is given to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and other marginalized communities. 

The application process involves submitting an application to the Gram Panchayat or through the official PMAY-G website. 

The timeline for the release of funds is generally within a few weeks after the application is approved. 

The implementing authority for PMAY-G is the Ministry of Rural Development. 

State governments and local bodies also play a role in the implementation of the scheme. 

Beneficiaries are required to complete the construction of the house within a specified timeframe. 

The scheme also promotes the use of local materials and sustainable construction practices.
